# BASIC_MATERIALS weekly digest — 2026-W45

**Coverage changes.** Ten CHEMICALS initiations published: BUY AVIA (Rp414 vs Rp304), CLPI (Rp2,098 vs Rp1,560), ESSA (Rp941 vs Rp496), LTLS (Rp2,315 vs Rp850), SRSN (Rp169 vs Rp100); ADD ADMG (Rp218 vs Rp191), DGWG (Rp287 vs Rp262); HOLD FPNI (Rp390 vs Rp360); SELL AGII (Rp2,149 vs Rp3,380), SAMF (Rp177 vs Rp270) [AVIA report](coverage/companies/AVIA.JK/report.md), [LTLS report](coverage/companies/LTLS.JK/report.md), [SAMF report](coverage/companies/SAMF.JK/report.md). APLI, MOLI and UNIC reached signoff but are unpublished. TPIA's 4 November results update is parked after two QC failures; the running mark is HOLD, Rp1,237 against Rp1,300. BRMS (HOLD, Rp323) and PTRO (ADD, Rp2,557) remain the desk's only published metals names.

**Deck moves.** Metals spot was refreshed on 6 November: gold US$4,063/oz, silver US$51.99, copper US$13,827/t, aluminium US$3,177, iron ore US$93.12 [metals deck spot, Yahoo Finance futures]. Forecasts are unchanged, so the gaps widened against the tape: FY2027E silver US$65 sits 25% above spot and nickel US$17,500 7% above, while copper US$11,000 is 20% below spot and tin US$37,000 31% below the September US$53,712 print [metals S2]. FY2026E silver of US$71.25 now needs a Q4 rebound from US$51.99.

**Material news.** Bahlil plans 2027 nickel output cuts through RKAB; nickel rose 3% to a five-week high [Katadata](https://katadata.co.id/berita/energi/6aeaa7421bc03/harga-nikel-tertekan-bahlil-siapkan-pembatasan-produksi-lewat-rkab); [Investor.id](https://investor.id/market/460915/harga-nikel-ngacir-ke-level-tertinggi-5-pekan-indonesia-jadi-pemicu). Freeport guided 820m lb of 2026 copper as its mine recovers [CNBC](https://www.cnbcindonesia.com/news/20261103201842-4-782053/tambang-mulai-pulih-freeport-produksi-820-juta-pon-tembaga-di-2026). SMGR booked a Rp532bn Q3 profit [Kontan](https://investasi.kontan.co.id/news/semen-indonesia-smgr-bukukan-laba-rp-532-miliar-pada-kuartal-iii-2026); ANTM's nine-month profit rose 47.9% [Kontan](https://investasi.kontan.co.id/news/laba-antm-melonjak-479-hingga-september-2026-simak-prospeknya). TPIA and three Prajogo entities have spent Rp830bn on buybacks [CNBC](https://www.cnbcindonesia.com/market/20261103114055-17-781837/4-emiten-prajogo-pangestu-buyback-saham-sudah-gelontarkan-rp830-m).

**What to watch.** Whether the nickel RKAB cuts are decreed and whether the copper and tin gaps close from the spot side; the November Pink Sheet; APLI, MOLI and UNIC signoffs; TPIA's parked review; cement demand into Q4.
